briefdescription.para: The daemon timeout, in milliseconds, when the manifest sets none or fails validation.
The window, in milliseconds, in which the watcher merges the events of one file into one event.

detaileddescription.para: It reports the changes of the files in the watched folders.

briefdescription.para: Creates the state rows of the run, and listens to the watcher.

detaileddescription.para: The rows are the files child, the roots child, the connections child, and the overlay row. The overlay row holds the message parameter. The application prints each change of that parameter. The constructor also writes defaultTimeoutMs to Id::timeout, and it sets the coalescing window of the watcher.
The members release their own resources.

briefdescription.para: Writes text to the message parameter of the overlay row.

detaileddescription.para: The manifest reading, the compiler manifest reading, the parse jobs, and the language builds all report their failures through this function.

briefdescription.para: Returns the name of the daemon of a manifest and a toolchain argument.

detaileddescription.para: The name is the hexadecimal text of a Wyhash hash. The hash covers the full path of the manifest, a newline, and the toolchain argument. The same manifest and toolchain argument give the same name.

parameterdescription.para: The toolchain argument. Empty when none is given.

briefdescription.para: Returns the cache folder of LING.

detaileddescription.para: The folder is in the local application data folder on Windows, and in the home folder on the other platforms. The function creates no folder. Callers create the folder before they write to it.

briefdescription.para: Returns the config folder of LING.

detaileddescription.para: The folder is in the home folder on every platform. The function creates no folder. The language folders are in the language folder below it, one for each language name.

briefdescription.para: Adds the folder of the manifest to the watcher when the manifest path changes.

detaileddescription.para: The base class receives the change first.

parameterdescription.para: The tree whose property changed. Only the state tree acts.
The changed property. Only Id::manifest acts.

briefdescription.para: Adds the folders of an added child to the watcher.

detaileddescription.para: The base class receives the child first. The folder of a file row is the parent of its path, and the watcher receives it only when it exists. The parent of each compiler manifest path and each dependency record path is passed to the watcher without that test, and the watcher asserts that the folder exists. A language row is the language folder. The processor creates that folder before it appends the row.

parameterdescription.para: The tree that received the child. Passed to the base class.
The added child. A files child gives the folders of its rows, its compiler manifests, and its dependency records. A language child gives its language folder.

briefdescription.para: Sends a change for a changed file, to the manifest, to a language row, or to a file row.

detaileddescription.para: The manifest, a compiler manifest, and a dependency record send a change of the manifest property, and the manifest reading then runs again. A file that lies directly in the folder of a language row sends a change of the path property to that row, and the processor starts a build of the language. Any other file sends a change of the path property to its file row, when a row holds its path, and the processor parses the file again.

parameterdescription.para: The kind of change. Not read.

briefdescription.para: The state of one LING run: the files, the roots, the connections, the language rows, the message, and the watcher of the folders.

detaileddescription.para: The model holds the rows of one run. A change of the manifest path adds the folder of the manifest to the watcher. A files child adds the folders of its rows, and the folders of the compiler manifests and dependency records that it names. A language child adds its language folder. A change of a watched file sends a change to the manifest, to its file row, or to its language row.
